install_doc.value: 80043-055-13 Section 4: indoor shipping sections joined with six 3/8-16 x 1 in bolts (provided) through existing holes in front and rear vertical corner channels; formed base channels with 0.75 in (19 mm) clearance holes in each corner (anchor hardware not furnished); through-bus splice connectors and hardware shipped with each shipping split, torqued per Section 9; on bus mounted front and rear of an insulating tube the U-shaped copper splice connector is centred on the tube with its slot pointing DOWN (Fig.14); ground bus splice with 1/4-20 thread-forming hardware (supplied) torqued to 100 lb-in (11 N-m)

torque.value: Section 9 (printed p.51) Table 6 Incoming, branch and neutral lugs by socket size across flats: 1/4 in 180 lb-in (20 N-m); 5/16 in 250 lb-in (28 N-m); 3/8 in 340 lb-in (38 N-m); 1/2 in 450 lb-in (51 N-m); lugs so marked require 620 lb-in (70 N-m).
